registered_vocabulary.source: runs/active/C4-V7FT-20261017/NEWMAP2_REPORT.md section 2 Moments/Moves (NEWMAP2-20261106), reused unchanged by PLANGEN/PLANGEN2. Nothing is hand-set.
registered_vocabulary.variants: lane_drop.VARIANTS: pair_g closing_pair 22 m/s 120 s dmax 1.0; pair_h closing_pair 15 m/s 90 s dmax 1.5; pair_t closing_pair 22 m/s 150 s dmax 1.0 + anchor; wall_g abreast_wall 22 m/s 120 s dmax 1.0; wall_h abreast_wall 15 m/s 90 s dmax 1.5
registered_vocabulary.r_sets: group_hold (R_random hold procedure): v_w {15, 18, 22}, hold {90, 120, 180}, dmax {1.0, 1.5}, 2-3 CAVs within 300 m
registered_vocabulary.law: a = clip((v_w - v)/1 s, -dmax, +1.0); positive acceleration up to amax 1.0 is allowed
registered_vocabulary.release: each member at its OWN drop crossing (distance_to_drop <= 0, NEWMAP2 x >= X_B) or at hold end; pair_t: every member when the closing-lane anchor is 150 m before the drop
registered_vocabulary.windows: target 15..22 m/s; dmax 1.0..1.5; hold 20..180 s (20 = registered minimum REMAINING hold of a join/relabel); onset 0 for proposals, 0..30 for join/relabel remainders; zone 400..1800 m before the drop; pair |dx| <= 100 m; wall spread <= 200 m
registered_vocabulary.online_draws: closing_pair: uniform over pair_g/pair_h/pair_t (pair_t only for a closing-lane initiator in the protocol); abreast_wall: wall_g/wall_h; group_hold: R sets; RSU: no pair_t (no CAV anchor)
registered_vocabulary.unregistered_extensions: gap_dv/zip (owner example) are representable but never drawn; they need MAIN registration

mined_rows.converter: lane_drop.plan_from_mined_row(row, desc) / move_from_mined_row(row, desc). SUMO lanes map through desc.lane_table. release_x must equal desc.bottleneck['drop_x_m'] and anchor_release_x = drop_x - 150; amax 1.0; common parameters across members. closing_pair/abreast_wall rows must fill their roles. R_random hold rows become closing_pair/abreast_wall when their lanes fill those roles, else group_hold. Lane-change roles or commands raise lane_drop.NotRepresentable (N9).

api.observation_block: lane_drop.lane_drop_features(own SensorReport at t, cav, partner reports, now_s, partner_ids, view) -> [25] float32. Inputs: the own packet at t plus the nearest V2V_K selected partners' own t-1 packets within V2V_RANGE_M. Fields: distance to drop, own lane role, closing-lane count/queue/mean speed/queue tail/coverage over [drop-500, drop] with report age and missing bits, adjacent-lane front/rear gaps and dv (own packet only), partner meta. Scaled into the trigger context and the residual (zero-init columns, after W1 awareness).
api.moves: lane_drop.LaneDropMove(family in {closing_pair, abreast_wall, group_hold}, members in role order, onset, hold, depth = dmax, target_mps, gap_dv_mps=0, zip=False, lanes (WM), anchor=-1|0). Executed on the single-writer committed-offset column: offset = law - native - MAPPO mean (CommandOwnership / speedMode 27 downstream).
api.protocol: lane_drop.Protocol (subclass of the W1 v2v_wall.Protocol). Options: LaneDropOption(lane_drop_initiate | lane_drop_join, kind closing_pair|abreast_wall, schedule, role_lane, covered lanes, anchor). Messages are visible at t+1 within range_m. One CAV per role lane; cap = min(member_cap, 2 | lanes). A session closes (no new joins) when its initiator passes the drop. A pair_t session publishes a release message when the anchor is 150 m before the drop; members latch it. Each initiate kind has its own F2 slot.
api.trigger_extension: lane-drop families are executable extension families (one-hot and all pre-existing trigger weights unchanged). 15 descriptor columns (LD_DESCRIPTOR) and 25 context columns, all zero-initialised.
api.ingestion: bank_breadth: with the protocol on, closing_pair/abreast_wall verified plans are taught as initiate/join (a pair_t anchor initiates; otherwise the reach rule); group_hold and protocol-off plans are taught as the joint label. Contexts carry the reader's own causal lane-drop blocks.

rsu_option.inputs: RSU field [30]: CAV self states plus locally detected neighbours, only from CAVs' own t-1 packets within range_m of the RSU (per lane: present, count, queue, mean speed, coverage, speed-missing, CAV reports; global: report count/age/missing, closing-lane queue/tail, open sessions, RSU session active, time since last suggestion). No ground truth or penetration.
rsu_option.suggestion: At the CAV decision cadence: a slate of none + up to 4 entries 'form abreast_wall / closing_pair at anchor x' from reporting CAVs' self states (registered geometry and variants, no pair_t). The chosen entry opens session RSU@t on the lane-drop ledger and is broadcast at t, visible at t+1. CAVs in RSU range, within 100 m of the propagated anchor and in an uncovered role lane get lane_drop_join. Same single-writer law.
rsu_option.head: lane_drop_rsu.RSUHead: zero-initialised output (uniform over available entries) plus a zero-init value head. ArmRuntime.train runs train_rsu: PPO on recorded decisions, return = mean per-CAV SUMO return of its own uplink CAVs, exact-KL guard at the layer budget. The optimizer is in the sidecar (ON only).
rsu_option.guidance_B_R: Identical code. teacher_target maps an arm's own verified example to the nearest same-kind slate entry (B: SUMO-verified pairs/walls; R: its random-teacher examples). random_teacher_target is the R random teacher's suggestion: uniform over the same slate. supervision_batch + RSUHead.imitation_loss give the CE. Bank wiring is left to N4.

caveats: Fidelity vs the verified rows (REVIEW note D): NEWMAP2 members ran lane-change mode 513 during the hold. N2 members keep native lane changing, and the law gets AR noise and the residual. A deterministic run with zero residual executes the law exactly. Record this as a known deviation in N4's registration.
Release uses positions known to each member: its own position always, and the anchor when sensed or received. Bound verified plans carry each member's actual release el.
Enabling moves/v2v/rsu adds new slate options, so an untrained ON policy can select them. Pre-existing logits are unchanged at init. A zero-init RSU head suggests uniformly.
G4 skips lane-drop options (G4LD is extending this).
Base move families (wall, gap_open, ramp_assist), W1/W2 and G5 still use the frame merge-zone constants. On wz3to2 they act in N1's projected frame. Whether to keep them is an N4 registration choice.
RSU CE guidance is provided as functions only; wiring it into the bank is N4's job.
